Teste.NotaIgnorado: Faded die: rolled, but left out of the sum.
Teste.NotaFalhaCritica: There is an extra penalty: the GM picks one or rolls for it (1d8).
Teste.NotaDesastre: Every die was wiped out by dread: disaster (critical failure).

Pre.SemHabilidades: No ability applies to this test.

Hab.defesa: Defend (+d{die}): uncheck to dodge without the die

Pre.AbracarEfeito: {custo} DP · the die becomes a bonus die

Erro.pd: Not enough DP for these choices.
Erro.impeto: Not enough drive for these choices.
Erro.pv: Not enough HP for these choices.

Pre.DicaEspacos: Extra dice take these 2 slots (limit of 4 dice per test).

Arma.JaAtacou: this weapon already attacked this scene

Ficha.DicaRolagem: Click a skill name to open the test window (Shift+click rolls right away).
Ficha.PrimeirosSocorrosCena: First aid received in the scene
Ficha.DicaCena: Resets this character's scene: clears the scene's injury and trauma tests, empties drive and analysis and removes until-end-of-scene effects.
Ficha.DicaPavor: They only apply to the next skill or aptitude test.
Ficha.DicaRelacoes: The dots are the bond's degree (click to change). Benefits are applied by hand; invoking marks the bond as used this mission and tells the table (at degrees 2 and 3, the chat card has a motivate button).
Ficha.ConfirmarRemoverExtra: Remove this area? Its die will be lost.
Ficha.RelacaoDescricao: How you feel about them (narrative only)
Ficha.DicaEfeitos: Injuries, traumas and effects (a tonic, a condition like prone...) are listed together here, each with its description. Create an effect or pick a ready-made one from a compendium (you can also drag an effect Item onto the sheet); ✎ opens the editing of steps and duration.
Ficha.DicaItens: Items can be used without wielding them, which saves the time of equipping and stowing. You only need to wield an item to hold it, and it takes up your hands.
Ficha.DicaHabilidades: Profile abilities come first. Abilities with an automation show their controls here; the others are just a description.

Cab.BaseDica: Maximum without effects (the base). Effects such as Deep Laceration lower the maximum while they are on the sheet.
Cab.MaximoDica: Base {base}; with the Condition tab effects, the maximum is {max}.

Bonus.Dica: Up to 2 extra dice, for this test only.

Ficha.PrimeirosSocorrosDica: How many times this character received first aid in this scene. Each adds +3 to the next DC (the GM adds it automatically on each attempt).
Ficha.DadosBonusDica: Bonus dice received (lost at New scene).

EfeitoJanela.DicaHabilidade: Created by an ability: it goes away on its own when the ability condition stops applying.

EfeitoCompendio.Vazio: No effect Items in the world or in compendiums. Create one in the Items sidebar, with the "Effect" type.

Ficha.MigracaoCondicao: Injuries, traumas and bruises of {n} character(s) converted into Condition tab effects.

Oposto.PorCritico: Decided by a critical success or failure.
Oposto.ProporDica: Proposes a contest: choose your skill. With a targeted token, it is the opponent; with no target, anyone can accept.
Oposto.ContraQualquer: No target: any other character or creature can accept.
Oposto.DescricaoDica: optional, e.g. grab the fallen weapon
Oposto.Rolou: rolled, waiting for the other side
Oposto.EmpateRepetir: Tied total and HR: both repeat the test until there is a winner.
Oposto.Repetido: Tie: repeated on a new card.
Oposto.DicaAberto: Each side rolls when the table decides.
Oposto.SemCandidatos: None of your characters or creatures can accept (select a token).
Oposto.SemPermissao: You cannot roll for this side of the opposed test.
Oposto.DicaDefesa: Defend: skill test + d6 against the attack (the pre-roll window lets you uncheck the d6, for a dodge). If you win, you take no damage (and deal none).
Oposto.DicaLuta: The defender chose Fighting: it only works against a melee attack.
Oposto.SemArma: This actor has no weapons (create one on the sheet).
Oposto.SemArmaCorpo: This actor has no melee weapon.
Oposto.NinguemAcerta: Nobody hits (the attack must win and reach DC 7).
Oposto.PorRA: Tied total: decided by the higher high roll (HR).
Oposto.PorSegunda: Tied total and HR: decided by the second highest roll.
Oposto.LutaContraDistancia: The defense used Fighting against a ranged attack (the rule only allows Acrobatics): the GM decides.

Ajuda.SemDado: {nome} cannot help with {pericia}: at least d6 is required.

Janela.RD: Creature damage reduction: {rd} (already subtracted from the final damage).
Janela.SemAlvo: No target selected: choose who takes the damage.
Janela.PedidoMestre: Request sent to the GM: apply the damage to {nome}.

Dano.PVZerado: HP at zero: make the injury test (DT in the sheet header).

Lesao.NotaNaoLetal: Non-lethal damage: +1d6 on the test and 2d20 (the best) on the injury table.

Efeito.removeCondicoes: Is no longer unconscious and dying.

morteSubita.Descricao: The blow is instantly fatal. The character dies.

morteLenta.Descricao: The wound is mortal, but adrenaline allows one last action. Recovers 1 HP and, if unconscious, wakes up. Acts in the next round and dies at the end of it; nothing can prevent this.

lacearacaoProfunda.Descricao: A grave, permanent cut. Maximum HP is reduced by 2 forever. It can happen several times, and the effects stack.

semOlho.Descricao: Loses the use of an eye: −1 to Perception and Marksmanship.

semMao.Descricao: Loses the use of a hand or an arm. Can only wield one item; on two-handed tasks, takes a step reduction or fails automatically, at the GM's discretion.

semPe.Descricao: Loses the use of a foot or a leg. Takes two step reductions when advancing in foot chases and on movement actions.

tendaoComprometido.Descricao: A tendon loses capacity, reducing agility and flexibility: −2 to Acrobatics.

musculoComprometido.Descricao: A muscle loses capacity, reducing strength and speed: −2 to Athletics.

orgaoInternoComprometido.Descricao: An internal organ (heart, lung, liver...) loses capacity: −2 to Vigor.

orgaoSensorialComprometido.Descricao: A sense organ (eye, ear, nose...) loses capacity: −2 to Perception.

cicatrizAssustadora.Descricao: A mark that keeps people away: −2 to Persuasion and +1 to Intimidation.

contusao.Descricao: A blow too hard to shrug off: Physical drops one step until the end of the scene.

surtoAdrenalina.Descricao: The wound leaves no lasting effects and adrenaline restores 1 HP.

Pavor.PDInsuficiente: Not enough DP to control or embrace dread.

colapsoTotal.Descricao: The mind cannot bear the horror. The body stays alive, but empty.

estressePosTraumatico.Descricao: Every time the character takes emotional damage, the damage increases by 1. Lasts until cured.

degradacaoCognitiva.Descricao: Fear eats away at reasoning: −1 to tests that use Mind. Lasts until cured.

maculaPsiquica.Descricao: The world looks greyer: −1 to tests that use Emotion. Lasts until cured.

chagaAlma.Descricao: Something breaks in the spirit. Maximum DP is reduced by 2 until cured. It can happen several times, and the effects stack.

retracaoDefensiva.Descricao: The character shuts down and avoids social contact: −2 to Persuasion and Intuition. Lasts until cured.

panico.Descricao: Gains a dread die (d6). If the character already has dread, the die goes up one step.

estupor.Descricao: The character freezes and loses their action in the next round.

injecaoAnimo.Descricao: The trauma leaves no lasting effects and a surge of spirit restores 1 DP.

Tabela.AvisoNaoLetal: Non-lethal damage: roll 2d20 and keep the best result.

Erro.JaRolada: This table is already being rolled or was already rolled.
Erro.Rolar: Could not roll the table. Try again.

Tabela.Manual: Choose the effect instead of rolling (GM)

FalhaCritica.EscolhidoMestre: Effect chosen by the GM, no roll.
FalhaCritica.AvisoLesao: HP reached 0: make the injury test with the button on the sheet.
FalhaCritica.AvisoTrauma: DP reached 0: make the trauma test with the button on the sheet.

vexame.Descricao: The failure becomes an awkward moment: the player describes the scene. No rules effect.

machucado.Descricao: You hurt yourself trying: Physical drops one step until the end of the scene.

desatencao.Descricao: Your mind slips for a moment: Mind drops one step until the end of the scene.

irritacao.Descricao: The failure gets under your skin: Emotion drops one step until the end of the scene.

acidente.Descricao: Something goes wrong and you get hurt: lose 1d4 HP.

frustracao.Descricao: The setback shakes your spirit: lose 1d4 DP.

perda.Descricao: An item you carry, or a purchase slot, is lost: broken, forgotten or stolen. The GM decides which.

nenhum.Descricao: Just the ordinary failure, with no additional consequence.

Aviso.semGrau: A neutral relationship (no dots) cannot be invoked.
Aviso.jaUsada: This relationship has already been used this mission.
Aviso.SoDono: Only whoever controls the character who invoked the bond can motivate.

Chat.Teste: +1d{dado} on a test directly tied to {pessoa}.
Chat.Ajuda: When helping {pessoa}: +1d{dado} on their test, on top of the help's step increase.
Chat.Motivar: Spending an action to motivate {pessoa}: they recover {dados}d{faces} DP.
Chat.AcaoExtra: If {pessoa} is in danger: an extra action to help them (tell the GM; the table decides how it plays out).
Chat.Manual: Whoever receives the bonus writes it down by hand on the test. The GM may also grant bonuses outside the rules.

Recuperacao.SemAlvo: Select your character's token (or have a character assigned) to recover.

Item.DicaUso: With a use limit, each use spends one remaining use. Consumable without a limit: each use spends one unit. Consumable with a limit: when the uses run out, one unit is spent and the uses refill; on the last unit, everything stays at 0.
Item.ConfirmarRemover: Remove this item from the sheet?
Item.DicaMao: Many items can be used without being in hand. Tick "In hand" only to hold the item: it takes one or two hands, and you have two in total.

Automacoes.impeto: Drive bar (failures fill it; spend it for bonuses)
Automacoes.impetoInicial: Starting drive (1 space every new scene)
Automacoes.analise: Analysis markers (adjust the dice after the test)
Automacoes.prontidao: Reroll a die (2 DP, once per combat round)
Automacoes.esquiva: Free dodge (Acrobatics opposed to the attack)
Automacoes.sorrateiro: Extra die on Crime or Stealth (3 DP)

Item.DicaNatural: Natural category (claws, bite, punch): takes no hands and does not need to be wielded. Creature attacks are natural by default. Martial and simple get their own rules in upcoming versions.

Desarmado.Descricao: Punches and kicks: LR damage, non-lethal.

Item.DicaArremesso: Thrown weapon: each attack spends one unit automatically, with a chat notice. At 0 units it stays at zero and cannot attack.
Item.DicaArmadura: Armor: worn, gives armor points. Several can be worn together and their points add up (the GM decides whether that is allowed).
Item.DicaEscudo: Shield: wielded (takes one hand, one at a time), gives no armor points and can be used together with armor.

Penalidade.Dica: The die of the checked skills goes down these steps while the armor is worn (or the shield wielded). The sheet shows the reduced die.

Armadura.Usada: Armor point spent: {bruto} damage reduced by {reducao}.

Equipamento.SemAlvo: Target at least one token to apply the damage.
Equipamento.SoMestre: Only whoever controls {nome} can apply damage to them: ask the GM.
Equipamento.SemUso: {nome} has no uses left and is not consumable.

Bloqueio.maos: No free hands: unequip a weapon or an item first.
Bloqueio.proficiencia: Martial weapon: you cannot wield it without martial proficiency.
Bloqueio.escudo: Only one shield can be wielded at a time: put the other away first.

Equipamento.SemMunicao: {nome} has no units left: you cannot attack with it.
Equipamento.MunicaoGasta: {nome}: 1 unit spent automatically on the attack ({restantes} left).
Equipamento.SemProficiencia: Martial without proficiency: the GM decides whether the attack counts (for example, with a disadvantage).
Equipamento.SemProficienciaArmadura: Martial without proficiency: cannot be worn or wielded.
Equipamento.SemCusto: {nome}: not enough to pay the cost of using it.
Equipamento.PassoDescricao: Item effect: {texto} until the end of the scene.
Equipamento.PassoRecebido: {nome} received {texto} ({item}) until the end of the scene.
Equipamento.DadoBonusRecebido: {nome} received +d{dado} in the bonus dice pool (one test).
Equipamento.MunicaoUsada: {nome}: 1 unit spent automatically on the attack ({restantes} left).

Habilidade.ImpetoPassoEscolha: Attribute that goes up one step until the end of the scene:
Habilidade.EfeitoImpetoDescricao: The attribute die goes up one step until the end of the scene.
Habilidade.ImpetoPassoTexto: spends 3 drive spaces: {atributo} goes up one step until the end of the scene.
Habilidade.ImpetoAcaoTexto: spends 3 drive spaces to take an extra action.
Habilidade.ImpetoAcaoDetalhe: Tell the GM: how the extra action plays out is up to the table.
Habilidade.AnaliseGanha: spends an action and gains {valor} analysis marker(s).
Habilidade.CuraSemAlvo: Target the token of the ally to be healed.
Habilidade.CuraEmSi: The healing is for an ally, not for yourself.
Habilidade.CuraJaCurou: {nome} has already received this healing this scene.
Habilidade.NovaCenaConfirmar: Reset this character's scene? It clears the scene's injury and trauma tests, empties the ability resources that empty and the bonus dice, removes until-end-of-scene effects and restores 1 HP if at 0.
Habilidade.AnaliseDica: Each marker changes a die by 1 point (minimum 1, up to the die's maximum). Markers available: {pontos}. Type the new value of each die.
Habilidade.AnaliseInvalida: Invalid values or not enough markers.
Habilidade.AnaliseNota: {nome} uses {habilidade}: {pontos} marker(s) to adjust the dice.
Habilidade.ProntidaoJaUsada: This ability has already been used on this test.
Habilidade.ProntidaoSemPD: Not enough DP to reroll the die.
Habilidade.AnimalFerido: got hurt and won't help for the rest of the scene.
Habilidade.Sorrateiro: +d8 on the next Crime or Stealth test (3 DP)
Habilidade.ProntidaoRodada: This ability was already used this combat round.
Habilidade.ProntidaoIndisponivel: None of your characters can use this ability now (already used this round or not enough DP).

Perseguicao.DicaManual: Carrying another and sacrifice: adjust the participants' AP and breath by hand, using the fields above.
Perseguicao.SemParticipantes: Nobody is taking part yet. Add the characters who will run.
Perseguicao.SemPerseguicao: There is no chase right now.
Perseguicao.SemPerseguicaoMestre: Create a chase to start preparing the scene.
Perseguicao.ExcluirConfirmar: Delete the chase and its list of participants?
Perseguicao.AdicionarAviso: Check the characters who will take part.
Perseguicao.SemPersonagens: There are no characters to add.

Pre.Regra: Adds the high roll on a pass or the low roll on a fail. The DT is the one in the field (the chase DT if the test has none).
Pre.Esforco: Extra effort: +1 step on the skill and lose {dados}d4 HP

Bloqueio.agiu: Already acted this round. To redo it, uncheck "Already acted" in the chase window.

Aviso.pericia: Already used this scene (by the rules, only once; the GM decides).

Chat.Esforco: Extra effort: rolled {perda} HP of loss ({dados}d4)
Chat.EsforcoPendente: The HP has not been deducted yet: {pv} HP to apply.
Chat.EsforcoZero: HP reached 0: make the injury test on the sheet.

Barra.passou: passed, adds the high roll ({pa} AP)
Barra.crit: critical, adds the two highest ({pa} AP)
Barra.falhou: failed, adds the low roll ({pa} AP)
Barra.falhaCritica: critical failure, adds the low roll ({pa} AP)

Pontos.Dica: For each round, the AP the participants must have. The last point is the final AP: adding a point in a later round makes it the new final AP.
Pontos.Vazio: No points yet. Add rounds and target AP.
Pontos.Invalido: Round (1 to 99) and AP (0 or more) must be whole numbers.
Pontos.RevelarProximo: Show the next target to the players
Pontos.EsconderProximo: Hide the next target from the players
Pontos.RevelarFinal: Show the final AP to the players
Pontos.EsconderFinal: Hide the final AP from the players
Pontos.AbaixoDica: Below this round's target AP (only the GM sees this)

Penalidade.Dica: With dice, the GM rolls once and everyone takes the same value. Each player who failed presses the button on the chat card.
Penalidade.ValorInvalido: Invalid value: use a number from 1 to 999 or dice (like 2d6 or 1d8+2).
Penalidade.ZeroPV: HP reached 0: make the injury test on the sheet.
Penalidade.ZeroPD: DP reached 0: make the trauma test on the sheet.

Cartao.RecuperarFolegoDica: Round action: recovers 2 breath dice and marks "already acted".

Erro.JaExiste: A chase already exists. Delete it before creating another.
Erro.NaoEmAndamento: The chase is not in progress.
Erro.SemMestre: There is no GM online to add the advance points.
Erro.AvancoBloqueado: The test no longer counts as an advance (already acted this round). It was rolled as a normal test.

Furtividade.SemCena: There is no stealth scene right now.
Furtividade.SemCenaMestre: Create a stealth scene to start preparing.
Furtividade.SemParticipantes: Nobody is taking part yet. Add the characters who will sneak.
Furtividade.EncerrarConfirmar: End the scene? Everyone's hiding dice will be erased.
Furtividade.ExcluirConfirmar: Delete the stealth scene and its participant list?
Furtividade.RevelarConfirmar: See the values of {nome}'s hiding dice? Everyone will be told in the chat.
Furtividade.DicaMestre: You only see how many dice each one has. The eye reveals the values (with a chat notice) and lets you adjust them.
Furtividade.DicaJogador: Only you see the values of your dice. The others only see how many you have.

Dados.AdicionarDica: Choose the die and the value rolled (for example, rolled at the table).
Dados.DescartarConfirmar: Discard this hiding die? It does not come back.

Chat.adicionou: {nome} added a hiding die ({n} in total).
Chat.encontrado: {nome} lost the last hiding die and was found!
Chat.revelou: {mestre} saw the values of {nome}'s hiding dice.
Chat.zerou: The GM reset {nome}'s hiding; they can redo the test.
Chat.distraiu: {nome} distracted the creatures: {alvo} gained 1 hiding die ({n} in total).
Chat.escondeuDeNovo: {nome} hid better: +1 hiding die ({n} in total).
Chat.chamativa: {nome} made a flashy action and lost 1 hiding die ({n} left).
Chat.chamativaEncontrado: {nome} made a flashy action, lost the last die and was found!
Chat.atencao: {nome} drew the creatures' attention: lost 2 dice ({restam} left) and {alvo} gained 1 ({n} in total).
Chat.atencaoEncontrado: {nome} drew the creatures' attention and was found; {alvo} gained 1 die ({n} in total).

Cartao.AbrirDica: The values of your dice are in the scene window.

Erro.JaExiste: A stealth scene already exists. Delete it before creating another.
Erro.Operacao: Could not change the hiding dice (invalid die or limit of 12).
Erro.SemMestre: There is no GM online to save the hiding dice.
Erro.TesteBloqueado: The test no longer counts as a hiding test. It was rolled as a normal test.
Erro.AcaoBloqueada: The stealth action no longer applies (scene ended or target left the scene). It was rolled as a normal test.

Furtividade.ZerarConfirmar: Reset {nome}'s hiding? The dice are erased and the character goes back to not hidden, able to redo the test.

Pre.Regra: No DC and no fear die. The dice are not added: they become hiding dice. The roll is private (only you see it).
Pre.EsconderRegra: No advancing this round. On a success, one of the rolled dice becomes a hiding die. Private roll.
Pre.DistrairRegra: On a success, one of the rolled dice becomes a hiding die for you or an ally. Private roll.
Pre.ChamativaRegra: Running, making noise... When this test is rolled, you lose the chosen hiding die. Not allowed with hide or distract.

Barra.Escolher: Choose the {n} dice that stay (click to swap).
Barra.Critico: Critical: when you keep them, an extra d{dado} is rolled and added too.
Barra.JaEscondido: This character has already hidden in this scene.

Procura.Dica: Type dice (2d6, d10) and/or values (3 5). Dice are rolled in public; anyone with hiding dice showing one of these values loses them.
Procura.Sorteado: Creature event: the drawn target is {nome}.

Erro.vazio: Type dice or values for the search.
Erro.termo: Use dice from d2 to d20 (up to 10 each, like 2d6) or values from 1 to 20.
Erro.muitos: Too many terms in the field (at most 12).
Erro.semAlvo: Nobody is hidden to be searched.

Tabela.Dica: Tables written by you (the system ships none). Each row has its result range on the table's die; choosing a row only fills in the search window.
Tabela.ExcluirConfirmar: Delete the table {nome} and all its rows?
Tabela.SemTabelas: No tables yet. Create one in the editor.

Aviso.foraDoDado: Row {faixa}: goes beyond the table's die.
Aviso.sobreposta: Row {faixa}: result {detalhe} is already in another row.

Tabela.SortearDica: Rolls the table's die for the GM only and picks the row.
Tabela.SorteioSemLinha: Result {n}: no row with that result.

Acao.Passou: {acao}: success! Choose the die that goes to {alvo}.
Acao.SemDestino: {alvo} can no longer receive the die (out of the scene or not hidden).
Acao.Escolher: Click the chosen die (with 4 dice, the one left out is not an option).

Condicao.Dica: Next hide: DC {dt}. A use counts when rolled; adjust here if something goes wrong.

Furtividade.DistrairDica: Distract uses in the scene, by any character. The DC goes up by 3 each use.

Atencao.Dica: You pass one of your dice to an ally and discard another: you lose two so they gain one.
Atencao.Passar: Die that goes to the ally
Atencao.Mesmo: Choose different dice to pass and to discard.

Consequencia.Dica: With dice, the GM rolls once and everyone takes the same value. Only those found right now get the button on the card.

Desafio.ExcluirConfirmar: Delete the challenge “{nome}”? Every participant's progress will be lost.
Desafio.Limite: Challenge limit reached: delete one to create another.
Desafio.VazioMestre: No challenges. Create an extended test to track a target score without taking notes by hand.
Desafio.AdicionarSelecionadosDica: Adds the characters of the tokens selected on the map.
Desafio.SemSelecionados: No character token is selected on the map.

Estendido.Dica: Individual: each participant has their own score. Group: everyone fills the same score, each one trying once per round. Adjust the points with −/+ or by typing (Enter confirms). On a test, the player ticks “Use in the challenge” in the pre-test window and adds through the card's button.

Penalidade.Dica: With dice, the GM rolls once and everyone takes the same value. Only the marked ones get the button on the card.
Penalidade.SemAlvos: Mark at least one participant to take the penalty.
Penalidade.SemParticipantes: This challenge has no participants yet.

Pre.Regra: Points are added through the card's button
Pre.EscalarDica: The DT follows the approach. Failing is a fall.
Pre.AlcancarDica: The DT follows the approach. Failing deals damage: LR when safe (and starts over), HR when risky.
Pre.SustentarDica: Each round already held lowers both dice by one step (the preview already shows it).

Teste.Indisponivel: The challenge is no longer active for this character: it was rolled as a regular test.

Barra.Fechado: Extended test ended (or the character left it): nothing to add.
Barra.Queda: failed: falls for {dano} HP, and the points go back to 0
Barra.ZeroPv: Reached 0 HP: make the injury test.
Barra.DanoZera: failed: {dano} HP of damage, and the actions go back to 0

Desafio.CustoDica: With a cost, each test's card gets the “Pay HP” button (pass or fail); 0 = no cost. For a separate damage, use the Penalty.

Escalar.Dica: Always individual. Each test picks fast or careful in the pre-test window. Failing is a fall: the test's card gets the button that deals damage equal to the accumulated points and resets the points.

Alcancar.Dica: Always individual. Safe: two actions in a row, each with a test; failing deals damage equal to the LR and starts over. Risky: one action with DT +3; failing deals damage equal to the HR. If the character does something else between the two safe actions, reset the actions here.

Sustentar.Dica: One character per challenge (the others help through the pre-test window's help). The first test costs the HP to start; each round held lowers both dice of the next test by one step. Failing drops the object and resets the rounds.

Equilibrio.Caiu: Fell! The crossing starts over; the consequence comes through the GM's Penalty.
Equilibrio.Pendente: Balance die: {valor}. Which d10 should it add to?
Equilibrio.SemDados: No balance dice left: the only option is to fall.
Equilibrio.ReservaDica: Balance dice left (empty = full pool: half of Acrobatics)
Equilibrio.Dica: Always individual. The player rolls 2d10 through the button on the sheet's challenge card: a difference of 0 or 1 balances; 2 or more starts a fall, and they may spend balance dice (d4, half of Acrobatics) adding to either d10. Each balanced round adds 1; when crossing or falling, the pool refills. The fall's consequence goes through the Penalty.

Fechadura.Invalida: Type in each field a number from 1 to that die's faces.
Fechadura.DefinirDica: Type the code in the order the dice were rolled.
Fechadura.TentarDica: Tries a code on this lock
Fechadura.PorRodada: You may try {n} times per round (Crime d{dado}).
Fechadura.SemSenha: There is no stored code for this lock (or its message was deleted from the chat).
Fechadura.Estragou: The lock broke: now only forcing it open or the key will do.
Fechadura.Auto: Automatic check (answers from the stored code)
Fechadura.MostrarDica: Show or hide the code (only in this window)
Fechadura.Perdida: the code's message is gone from the chat: generate or set another
Fechadura.SemSenhaCurto: no code (the GM answers at the table)
Fechadura.NovaDica: Resets the attempts and forgets the code
Fechadura.Dica: The code lives in a whisper to the GMs only. Players try through the sheet's challenge card, and each attempt shows up in the chat. Changing the complexity or the step forgets the code.
Fechadura.MostrarMaximo: Show the maximum attempts to players

Quadro.Dica: The group's scratchpad: each attempt shows up here on its own, and “New row” creates a theory row. Use ▲, = and ▼ however makes sense to you; nothing here is checked against the code.
Quadro.Vazio: No rows yet: try a code or create a theory row.

Criatura.RDDica: Damage reduction: subtracted from each physical damage before HP goes down.
Criatura.SemPD: {nome} is a creature and has no DP.
Criatura.ItemRecusado: Creatures only take attacks (weapons) and abilities.
Criatura.DicaPericiasTreinadas: Showing only trained skills (d6 or higher). Click a name to roll.
Criatura.DicaTodasPericias: Showing every skill. Click a name to roll.
Criatura.SemTreinadas: No trained skills. Use “Show all” to set the dice.
Criatura.DicaPericiasProprias: Freely named skills (instead of Aptitude and Craft), up to {max}. Default base attribute: Mind; change it with the tag.
Criatura.DicaEfeitos: Conditions (prone, stunned, grabbed...) with steps, if you want. Create one or pick a ready-made one from a compendium; ✎ opens the editing.
Criatura.DicaAtaques: Each attack is one of the creature’s weapons: the test uses the attack’s attribute and skill (DC 7) and the damage is the high roll plus the bonus.
Criatura.DicaHabilidades: Free text: the GM applies the effect. Contests between the creature and a character can be rolled with skill tests.
Criatura.DicaEstrategia: The creature’s default behaviour in combat (GM notes).

Mover.geral: Acted in the general phase (Shift: also acted)
Mover.distancia: Acted in ranged attacks (Shift: also acted)

Combate.Limpar: Has not acted this round yet
Combate.DicaIniciar: Start the combat to count rounds: on each “Next round”, everyone goes back to “Has not acted”.
Combate.SegundaFase: {nome} already acted in an earlier phase this round (only with an effect such as Readiness).

Socorro.Dica: Saves a dying character: they lose the condition, recover 1 HP and wake up. DC 7, +3 for each use on the same patient in the scene.
Socorro.DicaPassos: Without a kit: two step reductions. On yourself: two more. Each reduction lowers the higher die by one step (down to 2d4); the next window’s preview already shows the reduced dice.
Socorro.Aplicado: {nome} is no longer dying and has {pv} HP.
Socorro.AplicadoAcorda: {nome} is no longer dying, wakes up and has {pv} HP.
Socorro.NaoMoribundo: {nome} is not dying: first aid has no effect.
Socorro.SemMestre: A connected GM is needed to apply first aid.

Efeito.ModeloConfirma: Replace this ability's effects with those of the «{nome}» template?
Efeito.DicaModelo: A template fills in the effects of a ready-made ability; you can then edit each one.
Efeito.Legado: Effects from the old automation ({nome}). Editing any of them makes them this ability's own effects.
Efeito.Vazio: No effects: the ability is description only.
Efeito.SemUso: no automatic use in this version yet
Efeito.DicaPericias: None checked = works with every skill.

Gatilhos.falha: On failing a test with a DC
Gatilhos.inicioCena: At the start of the scene

Resultados.curarPV: Heals HP equal to the high roll
Resultados.concederDados: Gives bonus dice to the group

Quando.falha: on failing a test with a DC
Quando.inicioCena: at the start of the scene

Resumo.ajusteDados: After rolling, each point of {recurso} changes a die by ±1
Resumo.rerrolar: Rerolls a die that did not roll 1{custo}{limite}
Resumo.passoCena: +{passos} step(s) in {atributo} until the end of the scene{custo}
Resumo.Cura: heals HP equal to the high roll
Resumo.Dados: 1d{dado} +1d{dado} for every {margem} above the DC, for you and your allies
Resumo.companheiro: +d{dado} on {teste}; stops helping this scene on a 1
Resumo.defesaLivre: Free defense with {pericia}, without the d6{limite}
Resumo.passoCondicional: +{passos} step(s) on the attribute die ({atributo}) with {condicao}
Resumo.interceptar: Becomes the target of an attack against an ally{custo}{limite}
Resumo.passoAtaque: +{passos} step on the attack skill die ({quando})
Resumo.criticoAmpliado: Critical success with two matching dice of {minimo} or higher
Resumo.reducaoEscudo: Lost an attack with a total of {soma} or more: the damage drops by the low roll
Resumo.passoAlvo: On use: {atributo} {passos} until the end of the scene, for whoever receives it
Resumo.concederDado: On use: +d{dado} to the bonus dice pool (one test)
Resumo.municao: Ammunition for {alcance} weapons: +{passos} step on the attack, +{dano} damage; spends one unit per attack

Nota.passoCena: {atributo} goes up {passos} step(s) until the end of the scene.
Nota.passoDescricao: The attribute die goes up {passos} step(s) until the end of the scene.
Nota.condicaoAtiva: activated: +{passos} step(s) on the attribute die ({atributo}; {condicao}), in the Condition tab.
Nota.condicaoInativa: deactivated: {condicao} no longer applies, and the effect left the Condition tab.

Efeito.DicaCriatura: Creature ability: the accepted effects are extra die, action with notice and companion, always without cost.

Guardiao.SemMestre: No GM connected to record who takes the attack.

Item.Vazio: No effects: the item is description only.
Item.arma: The weapon effects only apply to attacks made with it.
Item.armadura: The armor effects apply while it is worn. The skill penalty lives in the fields above, not here.
Item.item: Extra die and tool apply while the item is on the sheet (in the backpack). Heal, step on target and action with notice happen when you press Use.
Item.escudo: The shield effects apply while it is wielded. The shield reduction shows up in the Resolve damage window of opposed tests.
Item.efeito: The steps apply to tests while the effect is on the sheet.
Item.VazioCondicao: No steps: the effect is only a description.

QuandoAtaque.primeiroCena: On the weapon's first attack of the scene
QuandoAtaque.naoAtacou: Against someone who has not attacked me yet

Efeito.DicaItemCondicao: This item is a template: picked from the "From compendium" list or dragged onto a sheet, it is copied to the Condition tab. Changing the item later does not change the copies. The key identifies a ready-made effect (injuries and traumas will use it); you can leave it empty.

Plano.SemMestre: No GM connected to give the dice.

Token.Migrados: Prototype token linked to the sheet on {n} character(s).
